name: Kiss Me One More Time
source:
The story is about a high school student who doesn't have any motive or passion in anything.
His life until now is meaningless but something unexpected is gonna happen.​

[From F95 Zone]
translation:
故事讲述的是一个对任何事情都没有任何动机或热情的高中生。
到目前为止他的生活毫无意义，但意想不到的事情即将发生。​

[来自F95区]
